case_name: Deoki Panjhiyara vs Shahshi Bhushan Narayan Azad & Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: Shashi Bhushan Narayan Azad & Anr. — husband and another

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Appellant, married to respondent in 2006, filed petition under Section 12 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 seeking reliefs including damages and maintenance. Interim maintenance granted by trial court at rate of Rs.2000/- per month.

legal_principles.principle: The legislative intent to include women, living in marriages subsequently found to be illegal or even in relationships resembling a marriage, within the protective umbrella of the DV Act is absolutely clear and must be given its full effect.
legal_principles.held: Learned counsel by referring to the definition of “aggrieved person” and “domestic relationship” as appearing in the DV Act, 2005 has urged that the legislative intent to include women, living in marriages subsequently found to be illegal or even in relationships resembling a marriage, within the protective umbrella of the DV Act is absolutely clear and the same must be given its full effect.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 — Section 2

legal_principles.principle: A relationship in the nature of marriage is akin to a common law marriage which requires, in addition to proof of the fact that parties had lived together in a shared household as defined in Section 2(s) of the DV Act, the following conditions to be satisfied.
legal_principles.held: They must be of legal age to marry. They must be otherwise qualified to enter into a legal marriage, including being unmarried. They must have voluntarily cohabited and held themselves out to the world as being akin to spouses for a significant period of time……
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 — Section 2
cited_cases: D. Velusamy vs. D.Patchaimmal, (2012) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: Appellant's application for interim maintenance affirmed by Sessions Judge and appeal allowed by Supreme Court.
